### Syntax

#### Recognized shapes

The following shapes are recognized by `ditaa`:

- **Document** `{d}`: A shape with a wavy bottom edge
- **Storage** `{s}`: A cylindrical shape (database-like)
- **Ellipse** `{o}`: An oval/ellipse shape
- **Manual operation** `{mo}`: A shape with a slanted top
- **Decision** `{c}` ("Choice"): A diamond shape
- **Trapezoid** `{tr}`: A trapezoid shape
- **Input/Output** `{io}`: A parallelogram shape

Example:

```
+--------+   
|{d}     |   
|        |   
+--------+   
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/document.png)

#### Color

`ditaa` recognizes color codes:

- `cRED` - Red
- `cGRE` - Green
- `cBLU` - Blue
- `cPNK` - Pink
- `cYEL` - Yellow
- `cBLK` - Black

Example:

```
+---------+
| cBLU    |
|         |
|    +----+
|    |cPNK|
|    |    |
+----+----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/color.png)

Common edge separation (default):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/separation.png)

No separation (with the `-E` option):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/no_separation.png)

#### Dashed lines

Any lines that contain either at least one `=` (for horizontal lines) or at least one `:` (for vertical lines) are rendered as dashed lines. Only one of those characters can make a whole line dashed, so this feature "spreads". The rationale behind this is that you only have to change one character to switch from normal to dashed line, and vice versa.

Example:

```
----+  /----\  +----+
    :  |    |  :    |
    |  |    |  |{s} |
    v  \-=--+  +----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/dashed_demo.png)

#### Point markers

If `*` is encountered on a line (but not at the end of the line), it is rendered as a special marker, called the point marker. Example:

```
*----*
|    |      /--*
*    *      |
|    |  -*--+
*----*
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/point_marker.png)

#### Text handling

If the pattern ' o XXXXX' is encountered, where XXXXX is any text, the 'o' is interpreted and rendered as a bullet point. Note that there must be a space before the 'o' as well as after it.

Example:

```
/-----------------\
| Things to do    |
| cGRE            |
| o Cut the grass |
| o Buy jam       |
| o Fix car       |
| o Make website  |
\-----------------/
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/bullet.png)

#### HTML mode

When `ditaa` is run using the `--html` option, the input is an HTML file. The contents of the `
` tags are rendered as diagrams and saved in the images directory and a new HTML file is produced with the appropriate `` tags.

If the id parameter is present in the `
` tag, its value is used as the filename of the rendered png. Otherwise a filename of the form `ditaa_diagram_X.png` is used, where X is a number.

In this mode, files that exist are not generated again, they are just skipped. You can force overwrite of the files using the `--overwrite` option.

This is best illustrated by the following example: ``` +--------+ +-------+ +-------+ | | --+ ditaa +--> | | | Text | +-------+ |diagram| |Document| |!magic!| | | | {d}| | | | | +---+----+ +-------+ +-------+ : ^ | Lots of work | +-------------------------+ ``` After conversion using `ditaa`, the above file becomes: ![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/first.png) `ditaa` interprets ASCII art as a series of open and closed shapes, but it also uses special markup syntax to increase the possibilities of shapes and symbols that can be rendered. `ditaa` is open source and free software, released under the GPL license. ## Getting it For Ubuntu, there is a [package](http://packages.ubuntu.com/precise/ditaa). ### Syntax

#### Recognized shapes

The following shapes are recognized by `ditaa`:

- **Document** `{d}`: A shape with a wavy bottom edge
- **Storage** `{s}`: A cylindrical shape (database-like)
- **Ellipse** `{o}`: An oval/ellipse shape
- **Manual operation** `{mo}`: A shape with a slanted top
- **Decision** `{c}` ("Choice"): A diamond shape
- **Trapezoid** `{tr}`: A trapezoid shape
- **Input/Output** `{io}`: A parallelogram shape

Example:

```
+--------+   
|{d}     |   
|        |   
+--------+   
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/document.png)

#### Color

`ditaa` recognizes color codes:

- `cRED` - Red
- `cGRE` - Green
- `cBLU` - Blue
- `cPNK` - Pink
- `cYEL` - Yellow
- `cBLK` - Black

Example:

```
+---------+
| cBLU    |
|         |
|    +----+
|    |cPNK|
|    |    |
+----+----+
```

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from probe import svg
import re
def body(content, extra=[]):
    txt=svg(content, extra)
    if not txt:
        print("NO SVG"); return
    # extract inside <g ...> ... </g>
    m=re.search(r"<g[^>]*>(.*)</g>", txt, flags=re.S)
    inner=m.group(1) if m else txt
    lines=[l.strip() for l in inner.strip().splitlines()]
    print("SIZE", re.search(r"width='(\d+)'\s+height='(\d+)'", txt).groups())
    for l in lines: print(l)
def show(content, extra=[]):
    print("INPUT:"); print(content, end='' if content.endswith("\n") else "\n"); print("--")
    body(content, extra); print("=====")

        ln=struct.unpack(">I",d[pos:pos+4])[0]; typ=d[pos+4:pos+8]; data=d[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
        if typ==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct,_,_,_=struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB",data)

            if filt==0: v=x

    print("---")

{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'
data=open("/tmp/cli.txt").read()
blocks=data.split("---\n")
for b in blocks:
    first=b.splitlines()[0] if b else ""
    # print concise: find ERR line and OUT starting if not usage
    if "ERR" in b:
        # get ERR line truncated
        import re
        m=re.search(r"ERR (.*?)\nFILES",b,re.S)
        out=re.search(r"OUT (.*?)\nERR",b,re.S)
        outv=out.group(1) if out else ""
        if "usage:" not in outv:
            print(first); print(" OUT",outv[:800]); print(" ERR",m.group(1)[:500] if m else "")
        else:
            print(first," [usage stdout] ERR", (m.group(1)[:500] if m else ""))
PY
"}

import subprocess, os, shutil, sys, re, hashlib

    if isinstance(content, str): content=content.encode()
    open(os.path.join(BASE,"in.txt"),"wb").write(content)
    p=subprocess.run(cmd+args+["in.txt",outname], capture_output=True, cwd=BASE, timeout=20)
    out=None
    op=os.path.join(BASE,outname)
    if os.path.exists(op): out=open(op,"rb").read()
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, out

def svg_body(data):
    if data is None: return None
    return data.decode(errors='replace')

def compare(name, content, args=[]):
    a=run(ORIG, content, ["--svg","-S"]+args)
    b=run(OURS, content, ["--svg","-S"]+args)
    status=[]
    if a[0]!=b[0]: status.append(f"exit {a[0]} vs {b[0]}")
    # stdout normalize Done line
    def norm(x): return re.sub(rb"Done in \d+sec", b"Done", x)
    if norm(a[1])!=norm(b[1]): status.append(f"stdout diff orig={a[1]!r} ours={b[1]!r}")
    if a[2]!=b[2]: status.append(f"stderr diff orig={a[2][:400]!r} ours={b[2][:400]!r}")

def stats(scale):
    imgs=[]
    for cmd in [["java","-jar","/tmp/ditaa_embed.jar"],["/workspace/executable"]]:
        imgs.append(run(cmd,scale))
    (w,h,ct,a),(w2,h2,ct2,b)=imgs

    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):

    print("scale",scale,"diff%",100*diff/total,"mean",sumd/max(1,diff),"max",maxd)

ORIG=["java","-jar","/tmp/ditaa_embed.jar"]; OURS=["/workspace/executable"]; BASE="/tmp/ed"
def run(cmd,args,files):
    shutil.rmtree(BASE,ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(BASE)
    for k,v in files.items(): open(os.path.join(BASE,k),"wb").write(v)
    p=subprocess.run(cmd+args,capture_output=True,cwd=BASE,timeout=20)
    outs={}
    for f in os.listdir(BASE):
        if f!="in.txt": outs[f]=open(os.path.join(BASE,f),"rb").read()[:20]
    return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr,outs

import subprocess, os, shutil, random, sys
random.seed(42)
BASE="/tmp/fuzz"
# Generate random diagrams from building blocks placed on grid
chars=[" "," "," ","-","|","+","a","b","x","*","/", "\\","<",">","^","v","=",":","o","{","}","c","R","E","D","_","#"]
def gen():
    h=random.randint(1,12); lines=[]
    for y in range(h):
        w=random.randint(1,25)
        lines.append("".join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(w)))
    return "\n".join(lines)+"\n"
def run(cmd,content):
    shutil.rmtree(BASE,ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(BASE); open(BASE+"/in.txt","w").write(content)
    try:
        p=subprocess.run(cmd+["--svg","-S","in.txt","out.svg"],capture_output=True,cwd=BASE,timeout=10)
        return p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return "timeout",b""
crashes=0; diffs=0
for i in range(200):
    c=gen()
    a=run(["java","-jar","/tmp/ditaa_embed.jar"],c); b=run(["/workspace/executable"],c)
    # only care if one crashes (rc!=0) and other succeeds (rc==0)
    if (a[0]==0) != (b[0]==0):
        diffs+=1
        print("MISMATCH rc",i,a[0],b[0]); print(repr(c)); print(" orig err",a[1]); print(" ours err",b[1]); print()
        if diffs>10: break
print("done mismatches",diffs)

#!/bin/sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
JAVA_BIN="java"
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" ]; then
  JAVA_BIN="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
fi
mkdir -p build/classes
# Collect sources
find src -name '*.java' > build/sources.txt
if command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  javac -d build/classes @build/sources.txt
else
  "$JAVA_BIN" -m jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main -d build/classes @build/sources.txt
fi
printf 'Manifest-Version: 1.0\nMain-Class: org.stathissideris.ascii2image.core.CommandLineConverter\n\n' > build/manifest.mf
if [ -x /usr/bin/jar ]; then
  jar --create --file build/app.jar --manifest build/manifest.mf -C build/classes . || jar cfm build/app.jar build/manifest.mf -C build/classes .
else
  "$JAVA_BIN" -m jdk.jartool/sun.tools.jar.Main --create --file build/app.jar --manifest build/manifest.mf -C build/classes .
fi
{
  printf '#!/bin/sh\n'
  printf 'exec java -Djava.awt.headless=true -jar "$0" "$@"\n'
} > build/header.sh
rm -f executable
cat build/header.sh build/app.jar > executable
chmod +x executable
</output>
